name: qram-sched
description: Machine verification of the theorem layer behind qRAM-accelerated online scheduling: bucket-brigade qRAM addressing exactness with O(log N) error exposure (vs O(N) fanout), Szegedy quantum-walk quadratic detection on scheduling search chains (exact walk simulation vs fundamental-matrix classical hitting vs closed forms), exact QPE amplitude estimation enforcing the 1/eps vs 1/eps^2 precision law, and the regret/query-ledger separation: stochastic replay streams move exploration from the regret ledger to the quantum-query ledger, adversarial streams keep the Omega(sqrt(kT)) wall (bit-identical decisions), and online-matching competitive ratios (1/2, 1-1/e) are information-theoretic caps quantum search cannot touch — only per-arrival query counts drop from O(n) to O(sqrt n)
